scope: Authored encyclopedia description of Geunjeongmun and its ranges, distinguishing initial and rebuilt arrangements. It is not an independently inspected measured survey.
relevance: Provides a scoped vocabulary for a lower-status timber range and its relation to gates, walls and exposed roof structure.

access.note: Full public HTML response retained unchanged in PalaceData and locally verified. Research agent matched the saved article passages to the live text read on 2026-09-22. These are source readings, not independent architectural surveys.

rights.statement: The page asks for article attribution and states that reuse follows KOGL; the specific article licence subtype was not established here. Individual media have different rights. AKS-owned images 34f1d8df and a5cf8843 were labelled KOGL Type 1, whereas museum-supplied images were marked unavailable for free reuse. No image was acquired or visually inspected.

artifacts.verification_note: Unchanged public response retained. Header/type and readable content checked; no remote synchronization check.

notes.statement: Kim describes a change from 단랑 to 복랑 at rebuilding and the relocation of Ilhwamun/Wolhwamun beside Geunjeongmun. The range description names a low platform, round foundation stones/posts, 초익공, 5량 and an exposed-rafter 연등천장. Its outer wall combines a stone lower part, plaster and windows.
notes.scope: Source terminology and described arrangement only. No exact spans, sections, roof junctions or general palace-wide default were verified.

notes.statement: The evaluation describes 복랑 as a distinguishing feature. This broad comparison is not adopted as a universal contrast with all other palace ranges.
